data.body: 8e5c RED->GREEN: taught scripts/gen_api_surface.py to serialize normalized return annotations for top-level public callables and captured rebar-owned class methods, including Signature.empty->null, actual None->"None", literal postponed strings without repr quotes, and live annotations via inspect.formatannotation. Added return-only drift oracles for both callable and method descriptors, regenerated tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json, and passed focused API-surface tests plus lint/typecheck. Mutation teeth: in isolated temp copies, dropping callable return fields or reverting method descriptors to bare param lists makes the new tests fail.
